mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM article ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{size}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id, a.category_id, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.name AS author_name, c.name AS category_name FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT t.name FROM tag t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON t.id=at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id =#{articleId}
SELECT * FROM article WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, content, author_id, category_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{categoryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE article SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
